key_reasoning.reason: New useToolkitSelection.toggleDefaultTool/toggleToolAndSyncDefaults logic plus a new defaultDatasourceTools.ts abstraction are consumed by Toolkit.tsx, AvailableToolsSection.tsx and ToolsConfiguration.tsx in the standalone AssistantForm, and separately wired into the workflow editor's AssistantTab.tsx/VirtualAssistantForm.tsx — two distinct product surfaces updated in parallel, plus the shared assistants.ts DTO mapper and assistant/configuration type contracts.

diffstat reports 20 files changed (1042 insertions) spanning src/hooks, src/pages/assistants/**, src/pages/workflows/editor/configPanels/**, src/store/utils, src/types/entity, src/types/workflowEditor and src/utils — well past the 16+ threshold for XXL, though roughly half of the files are new/updated test suites (useToolkitSelection.test.ts, Toolkit.defaultTools.test.tsx, AssistantForm.defaultTools.integration.test.tsx, AssistantTab.defaultTools.test.tsx, defaultDatasourceTools.test.ts, etc.) rather than production logic.

The exclusive-pair logic (toggleDefaultTool / toggleToolAndSyncDefaults / findExclusivePairTool) is new combinatorial state-sync behaviour layered on the existing toolkit-selection pattern — a follow-up commit ('Fix review findings CR-001..CR-004') indicates the first pass needed correction, but the final implementation reuses the established useToolkitSelection/AssistantToolkit pattern with no security or persistence-layer exposure.
